name: Haas VF-2 vertical machining centre
about: Links from Haas's VF-2 STEP (moonshot/library/stations/extract.py; bounds in vf2.links.json), in the world frame with the table top at z = 853 mm and the operator at -Y. Joint zero is the STEP's pose: table at the left end of X, saddle at the front of Y, head at the top of Z, doors closed.

masses_source.reason: Haas publishes the machine's 3,400 kg total, not per-link masses; the servo axes are position-controlled, so these only set inertia

y.reason: Haas VF-2: 16 in Y travel, 1000 in/min rapids

x.reason: Haas VF-2: 30 in X travel, 1000 in/min rapids

z.reason: Haas VF-2: 20 in Z travel (spindle nose 4-24 in above the table), 1000 in/min rapids

door_left.reason: The doors slide open by hand; about 600 mm each clears the opening

table_top.reason: The CAD's shells aren't closed; trainual measured this box from the GLB, and gave the cast-iron top this friction

door_left.reason: The panel's front is at y = -775 in its link GLB; the handle bar stands in front of it

door_right.reason: Its front is at y = -775 in its link GLB, as the left panel's; the doors run on separate tracks, so they don't collide with each other (moonshot/world/vf2.py DOOR)

pendant_face.reason: The pendant's face in the CAD (y -986.3): keypad and screen; the jog handle, E-stop and buttons stand proud of it

estop.reason: The E-stop's mushroom in the CAD, 40 mm across, reaching y -1035.2; cylinders here run along Y

cycle_start_button.reason: The CAD's lower-left button, 31.5 mm across, 10 mm proud of the face

feed_hold_button.reason: The CAD's lower-right button, beside Cycle Start

door_left_pull.reason: the vertical pull bar by the door's leading edge, standing 34 mm off the door on two posts, measured from its link GLB; gripped round at elbow height

door_right_pull.reason: the vertical pull bar by the door's leading edge, standing 34 mm off the door on two posts, measured from its link GLB; gripped round at elbow height

door_left_handle.reason: the vertical pull bar by the door's leading edge, standing 34 mm off the door on two posts, measured from its link GLB; gripped round at elbow height

door_right_handle.reason: the vertical pull bar by the door's leading edge, standing 34 mm off the door on two posts, measured from its link GLB; gripped round at elbow height

jog_handle.reason: The CAD's 80 mm dial, its front face 36.8 mm proud; at_mm is that face's centre. The axis points into the pendant, so a positive turn is clockwise as the operator sees it, which jogs +. 100 clicks a turn (one turn at .001 is 0.100 in, Virasak and Kepka); the detent and damping are proposed: under the card's 1 N at the rim, and settling a click in about a tenth of a second

keys.reason: Positions [x, z] on the face, proposed: the CAD's face is flat, so they follow the NGC keyboard's arrangement under the screen (function keys and PART ZERO SET top left, the cursor in the middle, the display keys top right, the mode and increment keys at right, numbers below them, letters in the centre, jog keys bottom left); 14 mm keys on an 18 mm pitch. A key registers at 2 N, under the card's proposed 3 N press

affordances_source.reason: The doors' handles placed on the CAD's door edges, to be checked against the render; the pendant's buttons and jog handle measured from the CAD's pendant (2026-11-02), its keys as noted

interlocks: cycle_start runs a program only with both doors closed
opening a door while running puts the machine in feed_hold and stops the spindle
the spindle turns only while running, or after M03 from MDI until RESET
in setup mode (the pendant's key switch) cycle_start runs with the doors open, the spindle held to setup_max_rpm

setup_source.reason: Setup mode as Haas's NGC manual describes it, which lets an edge finder spin with the doors open; the 750 rpm cap is to be checked against the manual
